Government and LIC Schemes Offer Investment and Insurance Benefits

Two schemes are being highlighted for their investment and insurance benefits. One is a government scheme for eligible unorganized sector workers aged 18 to 40, where contributions range from ₹55 to ₹200 per month based on age, with a guaranteed monthly return. Another is an LIC policy that offers a potential return of ₹25 lakh for a daily investment of ₹45, along with life cover.
